name: Fleet Atlas
notes: Every flyable hull, hangar preview, and local-space NPC craft (security, pirate, courier, freighter, prospector, tender, surveyor) uses class-driven metal, lighting, and silhouette cues instead of a flat one-tint dart.
Stars paint spectral photospheres — granulation, limb darkening, corona, and class-colored chromospheres for O through M — so a blue giant no longer reads as a yellow disc.
DEV → Fleet atlas hops a hull into local space; DEV → Stellar atlas sits off each spectral class. Flight, docking, hitboxes, and menus are unchanged.
Service worker cache bumped to farbound-v2.15.0 so Pages picks up the new render modules.
